display.description: Village Lanterns quest offer, reminder, and turn-in scene.
display.title: Village Lanterns

lines: Good. The dark edges of the village can wait a little longer.
Put Village Lanterns aside for now?

abandoned: I will take the lantern request down. Return if the watch still needs light.
abandoned_cooldown: I will pull the lantern notice for now. Let the watch reset its count before asking again.
abandoned_forever: Then the lantern request is finished for good.
unavailable: There is no lantern order here for me to fold away.

lines: Then keep the lanterns safe until you are ready.
Village Lanterns is still open. I can repeat the details, or close my notes if you are done.

completed: Village Lanterns is complete. The village can use this, and you have earned the reward.
inactive: The watch is not accepting lanterns right now.
missing_objectives: Village Lanterns is still short. The tracker has the exact count.
missing_proof: Village Lanterns still needs the lanterns in your pack before I can close it.
missing_target: Village Lanterns is not at the right count yet; bring the rest before turning it in.
unavailable: This lantern request is not ready to close yet.

lines: Then we keep the old ones burning and hope they do not blink first.
The watch posts need light, not speeches. Six lanterns would do more than ten warnings.
Night has been leaning too close to the doors. We need more lanterns before habit becomes fear.

inactive: The lantern watch is quiet for the moment.
reminder: Village Lanterns: I still need the lanterns. Bring the full count back to me.
unavailable: That lantern request is not yours to finish right now.

already_completed: The village lantern count is already settled.
locate_failed: Village Lanterns cannot be posted from here right now.
started: Village Lanterns is yours now. Bring the lanterns back when the count is ready.
unavailable: The watch cannot give you a lantern job right now.

lines: Tell me those are lanterns and not another clever excuse.
Hold the lanterns until you are sure; the watch will know where to hang them.
